opening.argument: The presentation urges viewers toward a Bidao ICO by highlighting a 30% staking benefit that drops to 3% after the ICO, while the sale page itself says “Sale running fast!” Small purchases are framed as capable of producing 10x, 100x, or even 1,000x profits, and purchasing one AVAX option is characterized as “already winning.” The material also presents BNB-collateralized loans and staking as a source of passive income, while describing the token opportunities as speculative moonshots. Although a commission disclosure and a warning that the speaker is not a financial advisor are present, the available evidence does not verify the advertised terms or returns.
